## Discussion

### DVC metrics diff

Command: `dvc metrics diff HEAD --targets reports/metrics.json --md`

`HEAD` had null text metrics, so DVC reports no numeric baseline (`-`). Current workspace
values:

| Metric | Current |
|---|---:|
| Traditional WER | 0.02770 |
| Traditional CER | 0.01722 |
| Traditional numeric accuracy | 0.95274 |
| Docling WER | 0.15359 |
| Docling CER | 0.12837 |

### Regression-test evidence

The multi-column regression test was deliberately exercised with the clear-gutter
extraction branch temporarily changed to return empty text:

```text
$ python -m pytest -q tests/test_quality.py -k multicol
FAILED tests/test_quality.py::test_text_wer[multicol-1-0.1]
assert 1.0 <= 0.1
1 failed, 19 deselected
```

The deliberate change was restored. With the column-order fix in place, the full quality
suite passes: **17 passed, 3 skipped**. The multi-column fixture now scores WER 0.000
for traditional extraction.
